provenance.source_title: Why Ancient Humans Went From Black to White

examples.psychological_goal: 第一秒把宏大主题贴到观众身体上，用观察指令完成零铺垫沉浸
examples.expression_mechanism: 第二人称身体锚点指令 + 口语化语气词缓冲
examples.example_text: Look at your hand right now. Whatever shade it is, yeah.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'现在就看你的某个身体部位'一句话建立切身相关感
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该部位与场景设定

examples.psychological_goal: 用三连否定排除观众脑中的错误答案，把科学问题升级为悬案
examples.expression_mechanism: 三连否定排比 + 第四句肯定落点
examples.example_text: It wasn't random. It wasn't an accident. It wasn't some cosmic roll of the dice. It was a survival story
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先连排三个'不是X'排除法，再用'而是Y'给出定性落点
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该否定清单内容；否定项必须针对观众真实持有的直觉

examples.psychological_goal: 用递进式绝对化排比击碎'大概一直如此'的默认假设
examples.expression_mechanism: 绝对断言 + 逐级排除退让空间的短句连击
examples.example_text: Every single one. Not most of them. Not the majority. All of them.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先给绝对断言，再用两句否定排除观众的退路，最后一句钉死
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该句式对应的事实；绝对化必须有证据支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 抛出主问题后立即宣布延迟回答，制造受控的信息饥饿
examples.expression_mechanism: 设问句 + 'before we get to that'延迟补课转场
examples.example_text: So what was it? Well, before we get to that, we need to understand something about skin itself.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在观众最想听答案时明确推迟，并给出推迟的正当理由
examples.negative_instruction: 不要机械套用该句式；延迟必须以'先补一个必要前提'为前提

examples.psychological_goal: 用自嘲式类比纠正观众对器官的误解，笑点与知识点合一
examples.expression_mechanism: 日常物品类比 + 现代生活场景自嘲
examples.example_text: the bag your body came in, the wrapping that holds your organs together while you walk around arguing with strangers on the internet.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'包装袋'式日常类比描述被低估的对象，再挂一个现代生活自嘲尾巴
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该类比与场景；自嘲目标应是观众共同的日常行为

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句对仗短判决为机制段落盖章，把外观重新定性为功能
examples.example_text: Dark skin isn't just a look, it's a shield.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在机制解释末尾用一句对仗短句完成从'表面'到'功能'的重定性
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该措辞；判决句必须建立在前面已讲清的机制之上

examples.psychological_goal: 把隐形威胁的 stakes 抬到繁衍层面，随即命名悬念对象完成回收
examples.expression_mechanism: 极端后果前置 + 'The molecule in question is called...'命名句
examples.example_text: can end a pregnancy before it even really begins. The molecule in question is called folate.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先给最严重后果制造悬念，再用一句命名句立即回收
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该后果与对象；悬念悬置时间不要超过一个呼吸

examples.psychological_goal: 用'双重威胁一个解'的收束给观众前半场论证的完成感
examples.expression_mechanism: 数字对仗句 + '不是有用，是强制'的程度升级判决
examples.example_text: two separate threats, one biological solution. Dark skin in Africa wasn't just useful, it was essentially mandatory for the survival of the species.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先用数字对仗总结结构，再用程度升级把'有用'推成'必需'
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该结论内容；升级幅度必须与论证强度匹配

examples.psychological_goal: 在论证顶点突然反转提问，把观众的确定感变成新的悬念
examples.expression_mechanism: 夸张语气设问 + 二连追问的反转换档
examples.example_text: So why, in the name of everything logical, did it change? Why did populations that left Africa end up getting lighter and lighter
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在观众刚被说服的刹那用'那为什么变了'反问，完成叙事换档
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该问句内容；反转提问必须建立在前文充分论证之上

examples.psychological_goal: 用反高潮笔法处理史诗大事件，制造冷面幽默并强化'无剧本'主题
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定仪式化想象的二连排比 + 平淡真相落点
examples.example_text: No one organized a meeting. No one announced a great migration. It was slow generational drift.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先否定观众想象中的戏剧化版本，再用平淡真相制造反差笑点
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该事件与措辞；否定的想象必须是观众真实会脑补的

examples.psychological_goal: 把代价推至'跨世代死刑'的顶点，让观众感到方向反转的必然性
examples.expression_mechanism: 三连否定铺垫 + 死刑级比喻判决
examples.example_text: In a pre-industrial world with no supplements, no fortified food, no medical interventions, it was a death sentence stretched across generations.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先用三连'没有X'排除所有缓冲，再用重比喻完成死刑级定性
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该判决内容；重比喻必须有三连铺垫托底

examples.psychological_goal: 用算法框架的一句话总结为整段反转除魅：无关偏好，只是输入变了
examples.expression_mechanism: callback 前文算法框架的极短判决句
examples.example_text: The algorithm had simply reversed its inputs.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在重大反转结尾用一句呼应前设框架的短句收束，完成除魅
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该框架措辞；callback 的框架必须在前文亲手建立

examples.psychological_goal: 用名人标本的反差特征组合给观众一个可视化的'认知崩塌'画面
examples.expression_mechanism: 证据来源标注 + 反差特征三连清单
examples.example_text: Ancient DNA analysis published in 2018 revealed he likely had dark to medium dark skin, dark curly hair, and blue eyes.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先标注证据来源建立可信度，再用特征清单制造'这组合怎么可能'的震惊
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该标本与特征组合；反差必须挑战观众的真实联想

examples.psychological_goal: 用现代播放器词汇为加速机制定性，笑点与机制记忆点合一
examples.expression_mechanism: 双因素叠加清单 + hit the fastforward button 类比
examples.example_text: The combination dietary vitamin D collapse plus population density essentially hit the fastforward button on European depigmentation.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先列叠加因素，再用一个现代科技动词短语为复合机制定性
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该类比与术语；类比动词的意象必须与机制方向一致

examples.psychological_goal: 用'不同路径同一答案'的对照引出概念命名，给观众一个可带走的术语
examples.expression_mechanism: 对照句 + 'This is called...'概念命名句
examples.example_text: They arrived at similar outcomes through different molecular routes. This is called convergent evolution.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先用一句对照描述现象，再立即给出术语命名完成认知打包
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该术语与描述；命名必须紧跟在现象描写之后

examples.psychological_goal: 用'全部源自一个人'的单一源头揭示制造血缘尺度的敬畏
examples.expression_mechanism: 绝对化排比 + 三个 one 的递缩聚焦
examples.example_text: every single one, no exceptions, is descended from one specific individual. One person, one mutation, one moment
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先用绝对化排比拉满范围，再用三个递缩的'一'聚焦到单点
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该对象与事实；递缩的终点必须有证据支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 完成高下倒置：默认状态不是落后版本，派生状态才是后来的修改
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定偏见断言 + 三连同义重定性
examples.example_text: Dark skin isn't less evolved or primitive. It is the ancestral state, the original configuration, the baseline from which everything else is a modification.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先直接否定价值排序，再用三连同义短语把对象重定性为基准
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该结论与措辞；倒置必须服务瓦解偏见而非建立新排序

examples.psychological_goal: 用格言句把全片压缩成一个可带走的宇宙级意象
examples.expression_mechanism: 把主题对象重定义为'某超越者提问的答案'的格言句
examples.example_text: Every skin tone is an answer to a question asked by a star.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习结尾格言的结构：把讨论对象说成某个宏大问题留下的答案
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该格言与意象；格言必须回收全片已建立的因果链
